title: Hanz Needs Help

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: New Thadd. You have a fishing stick, yes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: New Thadd. You have a fishing stick, yes?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I have eight personal requests to fulfill, an exploding bidet and a Nets-star who won’t stop redecorating my hotel rooms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have eight personal requests to fulfill, an exploding bidet and a Nets-star who won’t stop redecorating my hotel rooms.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Then I’ll be reporting you for a wanton disregard of financial opportunity. Good DAY!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I’ll be reporting you for a wanton disregard of financial opportunity. Good DAY!

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: No time for “might”. One of my esteemed guests, can’t say who (don’t ask) went on a little pauper's cruise yesterday.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No time for “might”. One of my esteemed guests, can’t say who (don’t ask) went on a little pauper's cruise yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You know, smell the waves, get a shot of themselves with a Dock-dweller, kiss a carp, that kind of thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, smell the waves, get a shot of themselves with a Dock-dweller, kiss a carp, that kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Yes, well it turns out they were less than careful and lost an item of jewelry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well it turns out they were less than careful and lost an item of jewelry.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: No need for the attitude. Get that necklace and there’ll be a reward in it for you. Understand?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No need for the attitude. Get that necklace and there’ll be a reward in it for you. Understand?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Good. I will transmit the rough location to your HUD. Now, please, move out of my way. I must find a plumber…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. I will transmit the rough location to your HUD. Now, please, move out of my way. I must find a plumber…

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I was trying to offer you an opportunity. You should take some time to think about why you keep making the wrong choices.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was trying to offer you an opportunity. You should take some time to think about why you keep making the wrong choices.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Don’t get funny with me. I do not have time for faffery. Will you do me a favor using that fishing stick of yours or not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don’t get funny with me. I do not have time for faffery. Will you do me a favor using that fishing stick of yours or not?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: It's a priceless heirloom. Grandma stole it fair and square, yada yada. They want it back and my job is to make that happen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a priceless heirloom. Grandma stole it fair and square, yada yada. They want it back and my job is to make that happen.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Will you do me a favor using that fishing stick of yours or not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will you do me a favor using that fishing stick of yours or not?
It's called a rod...
I might.
Not.
"Pauper's Cruise?"
What is wrong with people?
Sounds like fun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like it’s going to be my job soon...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like it’s going to be my job soon...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like it’s going to be my job soon...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like it’s going to be my job soon...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck with that.
Get it yourself.
I can help.
Unfortunate.
And?
I do.
